t_err_evidence: ACL template lists user:alice:rwx, user:bob:rwx, group::rwx, mask::rwx but omits the required group:research:rwx and default:group:research:rwx entries.
t_commit_evidence: setfacl --set-file=new_acl.txt shared applies incomplete ACL, overwriting the correct configuration and removing group:research entries
t_surface_evidence: getfacl shared shows group::rwx then mask::rwx with no group:research:rwx and no default:group:research:rwx line.
